Independent Institute for Social Policy / Mission


The main mission of the IISP is to support and develop ideas and initiatives that have a social effect and suggest new approaches to social policy.

IISP main objectives include:

  • academic research in social policy and support of independent research in this area;
  • creation of an extensive information base on the problems of social policy analysis;
  • organization of a free debate on most burning problems of the modern social development and social policy in Russia and abroad.


Key IISP activities:

  • grant support for independemt sociological and economic research in social policy issues;
  • conducting research in social policy issues and partcipation in international projects;
  • independent expertise and evaluation of social effects of decisions by the authorities, as well as by commercial and non-for-profit organizations;
  • consultancy in social policy issues;
  • creation and development of information pools and databases (databases of researchers and research organizations working in the area of social policy in Russia; information support; and data archiving);
  • informing a debate on most important social policy issues: organization and holding of seminars, conferences, round-table discussions, and other events;
  • development and implementation of educational programs aimed at the improvement and introduction of new knowledge in social policy;
  • publication of journals, and academic, educational, reference, and information literature in social policy.

ABOUT EEG

Economic Expert Group (EEG) is an independent Russian company, that specializes in consulting services on economic and financial policy issues to government officials on federal and regional level. Economic Expert Group was established in 1994 to render analytical support to the Department of Macroeconomic Policy of the Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation. Since that time EEG has been working in close everyday contact with the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Economic Development and Trade. EEG provides Russian Government with analytical support at the negotiations with international financial organizations, Paris and London Clubs of creditors, international rating agencies, prepares monthly reviews of Russian economy, participates in monthly monitoring of Russian economy, carried out by the Ministry of Economic Development and Trade. On the Government orders EEG develops short-, medium-, and long-term macroeconomic projections, participates in the process of co-ordination of macroeconomic forecasts between official institutions (Ministry of the Economic Development and Trade, Ministry of Finance, Bank of Russia) and between the Government of Russia and the IMF in the process of discussing parameters of economic programs. item.description:
О ЦНСИ

    Центр независимых социологических исследований (ЦНСИ) - негосударственный исследовательский институт, создан в 1991 году. В 1996 году Центр получил статус автономной некоммерческой организации (АНО "ЦНСИ"). Более 30 лет Центр проводил социологические исследования, был ресурсным центром для социальных ученых, некоммерческих организаций и гражданских инициатив. Мы верны гуманистической традиции в социологии; открыты новым людям, идеям, опыту; независимы в суждениях, выборе техники и дизайна исследований; творчески и профессионально подходим к работе.

      В 2015 году Минюст, а вслед за ним суды РФ, бездоказательно признали нашу научную деятельность "политической" и Минюст внес АНО "ЦНСИ" в реестр НКО, "выполняющих функции иностранного агента". Мы считаем все законодательство об "иностранных агентах" неправовым и антиконституционным; принятое в отношении АНО "ЦНСИ" решение безосновательным и дискриминационным; но в своей работе вынуждены следовать формальным нормам.

      С 2022 г. АНО "ЦНСИ" приостановил исследовательскую деятельность и не проводит публичных мероприятий.
